description: Press a key or modifier chord, e.g. 'return', 'esc', 'cmd-c', 'cmd-shift-v', 'arrow-up'. Named keys (return, esc, tab, space, delete, arrows, home/end, page keys, F1-F16), with or without modifiers, go out as HID key events with each modifier pressed and released around the key; a chord with cmd or ctrl on a character key (cmd-c, cmd-shift-v) goes out the same way on the key that types that character in the current keyboard layout (no such key: not_delivered, keyboard_layout); a plain character or a shift/alt-only chord is typed through cliclick. Pass app to refuse input unless that app is frontmost (focus guard). Chords that quit, log out, lock, force-quit, delete immediately or empty the Trash (cmd-q, alt-cmd-q, cmd-shift-q, cmd-alt-esc, ctrl-cmd-q, cmd-alt-delete, cmd-shift-delete…) are refused unless force:true.
